title: Weekly planning notes
prompt:
Write notes for a 30-minute planning meeting between Priya (engineering), Luis (design), and Nora (support) about slipping the mobile release by one week.

Requirements:
- At most 180 words.
- Use these exact markdown headings: ## Attendees, ## Decisions, ## Action items.
- Name an owner for at least one action item.
- Do not use placeholder text such as "lorem ipsum" or "TBD TBD".
